sourceSchemaObservedWith: Official OpenCode 1.19.0 loopback serve API session creation and noReply message; fixture rows below are manually invented, not an upstream database dump.

generation.method: Manually generated rows for all new session projections, event history and preserved tables; three sessions include an exact-prefix collision and a non-session aggregate; no user data or credential values.
generation.privacy: Only invented IDs, paths and synthetic no-credential values are used.

contract: session_context_epoch/session_input/session_message use exact session_id and reference session(id).
Durable session events use data.sessionID as aggregate_id; event references event_sequence with cascade. owner_id belongs to replay/claim ownership and is not a session selector.
Session.remove publishes Deleted then removes its aggregate history. Event replay executes projection callbacks, so deleting only the projection is incomplete.
Selected and reverse event ownership contradictions are rejected; message/input shared IDs must agree on session ownership.
credential/project_directory/data_migration/migration and all other unselected rows are preserved and checked; unknown user tables and triggers are rejected.
